account_access_or_security.description: login, locked account, hacked account, suspicious account activity
account_access_or_security.playbook: Acknowledge the access/security concern. Do not request passwords, full card numbers, OTPs, or other secrets in a public reply. Direct the customer to Amazon's official account/support flow and escalate if compromise or financial risk is alleged.

amazon_pay_or_cashback.description: Amazon Pay balance, cashback, missing cashback
amazon_pay_or_cashback.playbook: Acknowledge the missing payment/cashback issue. Ask for the minimum safe identifier through a private support channel. Do not promise a refund amount or timing without account access.

contact_or_customer_details.description: asking for contact details, links, email, or how to reach support
contact_or_customer_details.playbook: Provide the official support/contact route conceptually and invite the customer to continue privately. Never repeat personal phone numbers or sensitive details in the public draft.

customer_service_complaint.description: general dissatisfaction, rude service, repeated poor experience
customer_service_complaint.playbook: Apologize briefly, acknowledge the experience, avoid arguing, and invite the customer to share the case privately so it can be reviewed.

customer_support_or_escalation.description: already contacted support, repeated follow-ups, asking for escalation
customer_support_or_escalation.playbook: Acknowledge the repeated effort. Avoid asking for the same details again if they may already have been supplied. Offer escalation/review through a private support channel.

damaged_or_defective_product.description: damaged, defective, broken or wrong-condition item
damaged_or_defective_product.playbook: Acknowledge the damage/defect. Ask the customer to use the order's return/replacement flow or contact support privately. Do not promise eligibility or a specific refund.

delivered_but_missing.description: marked delivered but customer cannot find the parcel
delivered_but_missing.playbook: Acknowledge that the delivery scan conflicts with the customer's report. Suggest checking the delivery location/neighbours and then using support to investigate the delivery scan. Escalate if the package remains missing.

delivery_attempt_or_driver.description: failed delivery attempt, driver behaviour, delivery instructions
delivery_attempt_or_driver.playbook: Acknowledge the delivery-attempt/driver issue and avoid blaming the customer. Ask for order details privately so the delivery event can be reviewed.

delivery_delay_or_date.description: late delivery or changed/uncertain delivery date
delivery_delay_or_date.playbook: Acknowledge the missed or changed delivery expectation. Avoid inventing a new ETA. Ask the customer to share the order details privately for a current status check.

non_actionable.description: thanks, praise, acknowledgement, vague message without a support request
non_actionable.playbook: Respond briefly and politely if a response is needed; do not manufacture a support action.

order_cancellation.playbook: Explain that cancellation depends on the order state. Direct the customer to the order's cancellation option or support flow; do not claim cancellation succeeded.

order_status_or_details.description: order number, order not showing, general order status
order_status_or_details.playbook: Ask the customer to use the order page/support flow and share the order identifier privately if investigation is needed.

package_not_received.description: package has not arrived / missing shipment
package_not_received.playbook: Acknowledge the missing package. Ask for the order/tracking details through a private support channel and avoid promising replacement/refund before the case is checked.

payment_or_gift_card.description: payment, charge, gift card, card problem
payment_or_gift_card.playbook: Acknowledge the payment/gift-card concern. Never ask for full payment-card details publicly. Route to the official payment/support flow for account-specific investigation.

preorder_or_release.description: preorder, release date, missing release item/code
preorder_or_release.playbook: Acknowledge the preorder/release concern. Do not invent release dates or entitlement. Ask for the order/product details privately for verification.

pricing_discount_or_availability.description: price, discount, deal, availability, price match
pricing_discount_or_availability.playbook: Acknowledge the pricing/availability question. Avoid asserting a current price or promotion unless verified. Direct the customer to the product listing/support flow.

product_or_app_support.description: app, Kindle, Prime Video, Alexa or product functionality
product_or_app_support.playbook: Acknowledge the product/app problem. Offer a generic troubleshooting/support route and ask for device/app details privately if needed.

replacement_or_exchange.playbook: Acknowledge the replacement/exchange request. Explain that eligibility depends on the order/product state and route to the order's replacement flow.

return_request_or_policy.description: return process, return eligibility or pickup
return_request_or_policy.playbook: Acknowledge the return request and direct the customer to the order's return flow. Avoid promising pickup/refund timing without account access.

shipping_speed_or_fee.description: shipping speed, expedited shipping or shipping fee
shipping_speed_or_fee.playbook: Acknowledge the shipping-speed/fee concern. Do not promise an ETA or fee refund without checking the order.

tracking_or_carrier.playbook: Acknowledge the tracking/carrier issue. Ask for the tracking/order number privately and avoid inventing a carrier status.

return_pickup.description: return pickup, pickup not arranged or rescheduled
return_pickup.playbook: Acknowledge the return-pickup problem. Ask the customer to use the order's return flow or share the order details privately so pickup status can be checked.
